build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Primary mechanic A is complete and playable: Attack chain and combo system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanic B is complete and connected to A: Enemy launch and aerial combat. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

Primary mechanics C and D both affect live play: Dodge and parry timing; inspired scoring and grade system. Score 0 if it is absent, decorative, or cannot be exercised through player input. Score 1 requires connected state changes and visible success/failure consequences in a playable flow.

At least four supporting systems are implemented and connected: Light, heavy, and special attack input system with combo strings; Hit stun and enemy knockback system; Aerial launch and juggle state; Dodge roll with invincibility frames; Perfect parry timing window with counter attack; Combo counter and inspired grading system; Enemy targeting and lock-on camera; Special move input commands (directional input combos). Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

Include at least three opponents or fighter archetypes, escalating encounters, defensive and offensive choices, and a final match or boss with victory, defeat, and rematch states. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The rules layer maintains resources, objectives, selection, danger, progress, and outcome without relying on DOM text as the source of truth. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

A three-stage progression teaches the core mechanic, combines systems under greater pressure, and ends with a mastery scenario plus a working replay flow. Score 0 if the content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes player decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

Important actions have immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state changes. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled start flow, playable systems, escalation, final success/failure state, and retry navigation work without page reload. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from live game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: Bold combat silhouettes, readable hit flashes, strong anticipation poses, impact particles, and arenas whose hazards remain legible during fast motion. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The 3D third-person composition uses deliberate lighting, contrast, depth or layering, and themed landmarks instead of an empty default scene. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Interactive actors, targets, hazards, tools, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or synchronized audio feedback. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
